title: death.fell.accident.water
description: Modifies the kill screen on death.fell.accident.water to say an actual death message
body:
Modifies the kill screen on death.fell.accident.water to say an actual death message.

"Player slipped in a puddle"

This death message will activate when you get this death message by any means, as it replaces the placeholder text outright.

![The death message:](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dee1bcde0228c106338c97f949895e83f5e1b3e1_0.webp)
